# #05 QA (blind adversarial verifier): mobile layout, print, document.title

**Verdict: FAIL.** There is 1 major defect and 1 minor defect. Every AC passes as written.
Drivers: `.verify/qa/05/qa.mjs`, `qa2.mjs` and `qa3.mjs`. Each ran as
`scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh scripts/lib/stack.sh run -- node .verify/qa/05/<f>`, all rc=0.
The raw output is in `.verify/qa/05/run*.log` and the screenshots are in `.verify/qa/05/*.png`. I did not read src/ or the diff.

## Defects
1. **MAJOR: table cells do not wrap long unbroken text, so print widens the page and the PDF loses content** (rule 5, rule 12).
   - Repro: a table cell holding 500 `Q` with no spaces, at 390×844. The `td` computes `overflow-wrap: break-word`. The spec asks for `anywhere`. The table has `table-layout: auto`, so the cell grows to 5525px wide.
   - On screen the cell stays inside `table-scroll`, which is acceptable.
   - Under print emulation, `.table-scroll` becomes `overflow: visible`, so `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` becomes 5560 at a 390 viewport.
   - In `page.pdf()` only 108 of the 500 `Q` are printed. The rest are cut off at the page edge (`run2.log` cell-pdf).
   - The same happens in the wide fixture: the nested table in list in blockquote, and the 500-char cell. `print-dark.png` is a 5526px-wide page.
   - Paragraphs are correct: `p` computes `anywhere` and its 500 `W` wrap and print in full.
2. **MINOR: the comment action bar overflows the right edge on phone** (rule 8 and the listed edge case).
   - Repro: at 390×844, select the last word of a paragraph. `.selection-action-bar` spans 294 to 396 at innerWidth 390, so the "Comment" button is clipped (`selbar-phone.png`).
   - At tablet (820) and landscape (844) the bar stays inside the viewport.

## Other observations (not defects)
- On phone the overflow menu is a full-width sheet anchored at 52px with max-height 70dvh and internal scroll. It closes on Esc, an outside tap or an item click.
- At the tablet widths (820 and 844×390) the menu is a dropdown that overlaps the header bottom by 6px, which is within the spec.
- Tablet header controls are 25–32px tall, which is allowed: rule 6 applies the 40px minimum to phone only.
- Opening the menu by keyboard puts focus on the checked "Review" item, not the first item. It is still operable; this is cosmetic at most.
- An HTML doc on phone: the iframe is 390 wide and fills the remaining height with no horizontal scroll. The header is hidden in print.
- Edit and split views on phone, 320 and landscape have no horizontal scroll. The editor header shows no filename on phone, as §2.2 specifies.
- `/` restores the last local doc, so after visiting a `?filePath=` doc its title shows there. A fresh `/` is `md-review`, and the static `index.html` title is `md-review`.
- I could not test a pinned *older* revision: PUT did not create a second revision in the throwaway backend. A pinned current revision titles correctly.
- An agent comment with `endLine == startLine` (for example [6,6]) highlights nothing. This is the existing end-exclusive convention, not something #5 introduced.
